value.title: Debug underlays move to Geonical without copying an extracted tile tree
value.statement:
A pre-registry com.nextgis.mobile.debug workspace remains in place until an explicit, user-confirmed transfer: startup skips both local-project bootstrap and the delayed shared-catalog migration so extracted source folders are not rewritten before export. Only local raster underlays cross to the already selected Geonical project; Web GIS project identity, accounts, credentials, vector data and tracks never cross. The debug package grants read-only streaming URIs only to the pinned Geonical package and signing certificate. Extracted z/x/y tiles are converted directly into one validated raster MBTiles database with bounded SQLite transactions, one durable file sync and an atomic final rename; source data is retained and a persistent source key makes retries duplicate-safe. Stream progress updates the operation heartbeat. User cancellation, a confirmed catalog Back exit, or an inactivity timeout closes the active descriptor, removes the partial stage and releases UNDERLAY_MIGRATION only after I/O exits; toolbar and system Back never cancel a running transfer silently. One stalled source retry is allowed, but no transfer may block later sync indefinitely.
 Opening, receiving, finalizing, attaching and stalled phases with monotonic per-attempt elapsed time remain visible independently of byte changes. Finalization/attachment retain heartbeat/progress until close without applying the remote inactivity deadline. A late timed-out descriptor is closed before consumption; queued cancel releases its lease and UI, while running cancellation retains ownership until IO exits. Only the current uncanceled control may update the scrollable status; Cancel stays outside it. Wire format, trust grants, originals and deduplication stay unchanged. Reported ten-minute delay cause and actual large-transfer/OEM acceptance remain unverified.
